realWalletLifecycle.resumeCondition: The user operates the handoff Chrome tab at https://patchproof-nine.vercel.app/, clicks Connect wallet, chooses their Bradbury-compatible wallet, explicitly authorizes any testnet transaction they choose to run, and then asks Codex to inspect finalized canonical consequence evidence.

claimBoundary: This proves production Vercel rendering, user-facing first-screen simplification, wallet popup gating, real Chrome handoff, and write gating before user action. It does not satisfy or fabricate the mandatory real browser-wallet transaction lifecycle.
